title: Prediction Index — forecasts, standing claims, tests, historical theses and priority records
description: 4134 claims read out of the archive's deposits by the prediction sweep (2026-10-15) and grouped by its triage, topical and join passes (2026-10-17): each registered at its earliest statement, every statement quoted. Generated from operative-semiotics data/reading/; never hand-edit.
